name: Member's Mark 16" Five Cheese Take 'N Bake Pizza
searchKeywords: members mark take and bake pizza
whyItWorks: Soft pizzeria-style crust topped with mild tomato sauce, mozzarella, provolone, cheddar, and parmesan. Far safer than pepperoni or sausage pizzas, though dairy fat requires good tolerance.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake until cheese is lightly melted. Dab top with a paper towel to remove pooled butterfat.
